items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: So I went down to Fid's Fiddle Shop and I went in and asked him about a bass.

ctx.x: Well, I'm thinking $75, wow. I didn't know it cost that much. I don't know what I was thinking because $75 for a bass is like a steal. And he said, 'If you get the bass, call me, because you know I teach.' And oh, hey, the whole thing, a light went off in my head, 'You'll never teach me!'

But I went down to see that bass, to take a look at that bass a couple days after that day. I was really curious, it was really on my mind. So I went down to Fid's Fiddle Shop and I went in and asked him about a bass. He said, 'Oh, yeah, I know what you're talking. Stuff sent you over here, yeah. So I'll show you the bass.' Then he explained to me that the guy had the bass worked at the Allison Air...the plant where they make aircraft parts or whatever. He said this guy was a night watchman out there. He owned a…

But he told the guy to sell, he wanted to get rid of one. He didn't care which one. Whichever he sold, he'd keep the other one, the guitar or the bass, and he had these instruments. And I saw the bass and I looked at it, not knowing how to appraise it or put a value on it. All I could think, '75 bucks,' which I didn't have to put on a bass. But I remember, I took the bass.
